services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Does your child dream of being the karate kid or a black belt ninja? This year, make their birthday wish come true! Zone offers amazing 90-minute birthday parties with fun, entertainment, and memorable lessons. An experienced Zone instructor leads the party by teaching basic blocks against a bully grabbing, engaging confidence drills, and fun karate games that focus on team building. Our parties are energetic and action-packed! The birthday child will never forget wearing the honorary birthday black belt, breaking a real board in front on their friends, and cutting their cake with a samurai sword. Guests will be invited to autograph the broken board as a memorable birthday souvenir. All
